LanguageData.RM_TwilightWellClosingText: The well overhead is healing shut — the rim has thickened and dulled, and the light is going out of it. Whatever you've placed under it will sit in the dark once it closes.
LanguageData.RM_SunSphere_Husk: Husk — needs a fresh wild seed (a pallu or a lamp bladder).
LanguageData.RM_SunSphere_Seeded: Seeded — dark, just beginning to culture.
LanguageData.RM_SunSphere_Mature: Mature — a small sun of its own.
